consequence.statement: The CRD bundle now also serves the external-secrets.io/v1 version of ClusterExternalSecret. The evidence states no required operator action.

original.statement: The CRD bundle adds a new served API version, external-secrets.io/v1, for ClusterExternalSecret.

decision.reason: [ev-d301cc59e35c] and [ev-a23e95fbb363] show that external-secrets.io/v1 ClusterExternalSecret is missing from the 0.15.0 render and served in 0.16.0. [ev-1061f4fcca14] shows the v1 version entry was added. Nothing in the evidence says that adding this version makes anything fail, get rejected, stop being honoured or need migration, so "none" fits this change. The storage flip in [ev-a93bb3b1d26d], the removed conversion webhook in [ev-1265a0fa1fc4] and the narrowed engineVersion enum in [ev-4a59a055cae7] are separate diff items that should be judged as their own changes, not added to this one.
